title: DeepSeek Harness
note: The forks are built from this tag's source through the unmodified official packages/client/tsdown.client.ts preset. Only the preset's node half is dropped (it needs a workspace-wide tsc project graph that the fork does not change); with DSH_BUILD_FACE unset the client entry is src/client/index.ts, so the browser artifact builds straight from TSX. Acquiring the tag: `git fetch` of this tag hangs in this environment (smart-HTTP) and codeload.github.com was unreachable from this network, so the tarball was fetched through https://gh-proxy.com plus the codeload URL and vendored. `commit` is the dshBuildCommit stamped into the desktop application manifest for this runtime (the tarball carries no git sha and the registry publishes no gitHead for these packages).
fidelity: 0.2.0-rc.2 fidelity was proven by scripts/compare-client-bundles.mjs (EQUIVALENT for ui-layout, semantically equal for ui-workspace/ui-user-questions). The 0.2.1-rc.2 port keeps the same pipeline; parity is re-measured with the same script.
